goal: Make production project planning consume one goal-driven GoalSpec and dynamic Project Plan without Knowledge Studio fallback or delivery-gate changes.
acceptance_criteria: Existing test, runtime, visual, review, packaging, and delivery truth semantics remain unchanged.
Knowledge Studio capabilities appear only when the user goal explicitly requests that product domain.
Pomodoro, CSV cleaning, and visual-novel editor goals produce distinct capabilities, user flows, entities, business workstreams, leaf scopes, outputs, and test intents.
The Telegram Provider path consumes the canonical GoalSpec and project plan through its existing component and leaf context without adding a generation route.
Unknown but sufficiently explicit goals receive a goal-derived plan or an explicit NEEDS_REWORK result, never an unrelated Knowledge Studio plan.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: bounded context and affected-work repair at increasing project scale
quality_metrics.target: context remains within configured budgets and unrelated checkpoints remain reusable
quality_metrics.method: generation scale ladder and ACFV-scale trial

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: requirement decision is the sole owner of canonical GoalSpec and GoalDrivenProjectPlan creation
discovery, requirement blueprint, Provider component leaves, and controlled Agent Tree receive the same canonical goal and plan values
existing Provider validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public delivery gate, and delivery manifest contracts remain authoritative
unsupported or insufficient goals return NEEDS_REWORK rather than an unrelated product template
evidence_refs: pytest provider and delivery gates (PASS: 210 passed, 41 skipped)

feedback: Canonical GoalSpec and GoalDrivenProjectPlan now drive discovery, requirement blueprint, Provider component leaves, and controlled Agent Tree projections.

worked: Centralizing planning in requirement decision exposed and removed the downstream fixed-candidate mismatch.
did_not_work: The official quick profile default 300-second wall-clock limit expired before the unchanged test set completed.
experiments: Retain the same quick selection but allow a 900-second CI wall-clock budget; the final suite completed in 691.055 seconds with zero failures.
